stop_policy: Stop on first failure, any absolute within-group off/off difference above 5%, source/config changes, oversized raw results or disk reserve; no automatic extra groups
retention: Only explicitly opted-in, successful non-checkpoint Exp1 private images are removed after ownership/resource checks and hash inventory; failed or checkpoint runs keep verified image archives or original data
disk_start_budget: 40 GiB serial launch margin plus 128 MiB raw results per remaining run; 20 GiB runtime stop, 0.25 second polling
measurement: Original full guest runner controller call including initial Git preparation; sandbox/template lifecycle and sampler startup/stop excluded; host sampler runs across entire exercise
cpu_cache_policy: Existing host frequency/affinity and harness cache defaults; fresh private template and VM per replay; no guest/host cache drop
comparison_scope: TrEnv-X host-only 1 Hz sampler; no cross-backend speed or memory-benefit claim
acceptance: Exactly five unchanged independent groups; control log-ratio mean t95 interval inside [-5,5]%; monitoring interval upper bound <=5%; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
image_restoration_from_new_runs: UNAVAILABLE_BY_DESIGN; raw inputs/configuration/output/metrics and image hashes retained
next_step: Selected profile clean-directory and checkpoint/restore reproduction; retain explicit file-state-only semantics for TrEnv-X; checkpoint live launcher still requires >48 GiB
